senses.gloss: Liked, cherished.
The apparatus to send and/or receive signals on a line, such as a telephone or network device.
The end point of a transportation system, or the town or city in which it is located.
Yes, that is correct; I agree.
expression of pleasure, joy or great excitement — see also yay, whoo, yippee
Yes.
(music) The seventh note in the C major scale.
(music) A syllable used in solfège to represent the seventh note of a major scale.
Yes; yea; a word expressing assent, or an affirmative answer to a question.
A polity or community.
The territory of a nation; a sovereign state or a region once independent and still distinct in institutions, language, etc.
An administrative subdivision of certain countries, including Canada and China.
(historical, Ancient Rome) A district of the Roman Empire at the third echelon
Having insufficient guns compared to the enemy.
In a convenient manner, form, or situation; without difficulty.
A person who does, or offers to do, a demeaning or dishonourable activity for money or personal gain; someone who acts in a dishonourable way for personal advantage.
A person, typically someone other than a family member, spouse or lover, whose company one enjoys and towards whom one feels affection.
(chiefly, in the plural) One in the same condition, or situation of need, as another.
A male friend.
A friend, acquaintance, or partner; someone with whom one spends time or accompanies
(AAVE) Someone, particularly a friend or male acquaintance, from one's hometown.
(dated) A friend; a pal.
(informal, originally, Cambridge University) A close friend.
A person who was a fellow attendee at one's school.
A dwelling.
A verb paradigm found in certain languages, usually an unmarked form or one that expresses the perfective or aorist aspect.
A proposed sensitive, erogenous zone on the anterior wall of the vagina.
A type of spacecraft capable of traveling to the solar systems of other stars.
Any structure made from earth, especially an embankment used for fortification or flood control.
Having plenty of space; roomy; capacious.
Literature composed in verse or language exhibiting conscious attention to patterns and rhythm.
A literary piece written in verse.
To raise; to lift; to elevate (especially, to raise or lift to a desired elevation, by means of tackle or pulley, said of a sail, a flag, a heavy package or weight).
An annuity paid regularly as benefit due to a retired employee, serviceman etc. in consideration of past services, originally and chiefly by a government but also by various private pension schemes.
The taking in by anyone of other people's livestock to graze at a certain rate.
A city, the capital of Konya Province, Turkey.
(now, especially) Either of a pair of braids or tails worn on the sides of the head.
Generous; permitting liberty; willing to give unsparingly.
Willing to give and share unsparingly; showing a readiness to give more (especially money) than is expected or needed.
Noble, kind and generous.
By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that.
(rare) A en given name.
To move into a foreign country to stay permanently.
The loud rumbling, cracking, or crashing sound caused by expansion of rapidly heated air around a lightning bolt.
of acts
consisting of a half
pertaining to history
Very important; noteworthy: having importance or significance in history.
A basic or essential supply.
(legal) A neighborhood or near place; the place or county in which anything is alleged to have happened; also, the place where an action is laid, or the district from which a jury comes.
A group of sentient beings, particularly people, distinguished by common ancestry, heritage or characteristics (see Wikipedia's article on historical definitions of race):
A race or lineage; offspring or issue.
Placed under the power of another; owing allegiance to a particular sovereign or state.
person owned by another
One who is hired to perform regular household or other duties, and receives compensation. As opposed to a slave.
Having the splendor of a legend; fabled.
A pattern, as an element of a work of art or architecture.

A culturally significant city surrounded by mountains in south-central Albania, located on the right bank of the river Osum and west of the Tomorr mountain range; it is the seat of its eponymous county, municipality and municipal unit.
A commencement ceremony.
(education) A graduation ceremony, from a school, college or university. Sometimes before the actual graduation.

One who willingly accepts being put to death or willingly accepts challenging and exposing iniquity done to oneself for adhering openly to one's religious beliefs; notably, saints canonized after red martyrdom.
An act or instance of putting clothes on.
Of or relating to the Caucasus region or its culture, languages, and people.
(geopolitics) A geopolitical region in Eastern Europe and Western Asia, deriving its name from the aforementioned mountains.
An incident or event that disgraces or damages the reputation of the persons or organization involved.
Great dishonor, shame, or humiliation.
A house owned not as a primary residence and used as vacation home during warm weather months of the year.
Something done, often so as to accomplish a purpose.
action
A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.
A corridor; a hallway.
A narrow hall or passage with rooms leading off it, as in a building or in a railway carriage.
A passage between two rows of cabins in a ship.
Having the form of a line; straight or roughly straight; following a direct course.
Of or pertaining to numbers.
Of or pertaining to demography.
A large round stone used for grinding grain.
The area surrounding someone or something, together with the objects and circumstances in the vicinity; the environment or ambiance.
The outside boundary, parts or surface of something.
A biomolecule that catalyses a biological chemical reaction: either a globular protein with this function or an RNA molecule with this function.
Any of very many crustaceans, of the order Isopoda, that have a flattened body and no carapace.

Any of the terrestrial isopod crustaceans of the suborder Oniscidea, which have a rigid, segmented exoskeleton, often being capable of rolling into a ball, and feed only on dead plant matter, usually living in damp, dark places, such as under stones or bark.
Of art or other things: appealing to the tastes of an intellectual or sophisticated (sense 1) person; cerebral; also, cultured, elegant, refined.
Elusive; difficult to capture or observe due to constantly outwitting the adversaries.
Action or form of speech deliberately intended to be rude; (countable) a particular act or statement having this effect.
The act of humiliating or humbling someone; abasement of pride; mortification.
(uncountable) A feeling of contempt or scorn.
insult or slight
(uncountable) Contempt or disdain.
A disparaging, belittling, or derogatory word or expression.
A compound or mixture of compounds used to treat or test materials, samples, other compounds or reactants in a laboratory or sometimes an industrial setting.
(chemistry) Any of the participants present at the start of a chemical reaction, specifically one that is consumed during the reaction.
Any of several green citrus fruit, somewhat smaller and sharper-tasting than a lemon.
(historical) A Russian communist revolutionary, a member of the Bolshevik Party in the Communist Revolution of Russia in 1917.
One who, or that which, coordinates.
To take or to test a sample or samples of.
A type of small boat, covered over by a surface deck, powered by the occupant or occupants using a double-bladed paddle in a sitting position, from a hole in the surface deck.
The state of being a citizen; the status of a citizen.
A place or room where laundering is done - including, by extension, other forms of laundering than clothes washing.
A mechanism or machinery; the means by which something happens.
A (mechanical) device to perform a certain task.
A plant of various species, chiefly cruciferous. The leaves have a moderately pungent taste, and are used as a salad and antiscorbutic.
The capital city of West Flanders province, Belgium.
Any form of an element that has a distinctly different molecular structure to another form of the same element, with different physical properties and often different chemical properties.
The process of anodizing.

(Greek mythology) A mythical semidivine hero, the son of Peleus by the nereid Thetis, and prince of the Myrmidons, who features in the Iliad as a central character and the foremost warrior of the Achaean (Greek) camp.
Of, pertaining to, or containing spice.
Armed resistance to an established government or ruler.
A popular revolt that attempts to overthrow a government or its policies; an insurgency or insurrection.
An act of revolting.
Any fuel that is obtained from a renewable biological resource, especially from biomass.
A trainee, especially in a skilled trade.
An infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium leprae, gradually producing nerve damage and patches of skin necrosis and historically handled by permanently quarantining its sufferers.

A disease characterised by inflammation of the intestines, especially the colon (large intestine), accompanied by pus (white blood cells) in the feces, fever, pain in the abdomen, high-volume diarrhea, and possible blood in the feces.
(medicine) An infectious disease caused by the parasitic protozoan Entamoeba histolytica; amoebic dysentery.
physics, measure of opposition to flow of current
Of or relating to Indonesia or its people or language.
A male ferret.
Wheat grains that are harvested while still unripe and then roasted.
(economics) Initialism of gross domestic product.
Any of various blowflies of the genus Calliphora that have an iridescent metallic-blue body and make a loud buzzing noise when flying.
The carrying or transportation of goods by a porter (“person who carries luggage and related objects”) or other person.
The creation of charts and maps based on the layout of a territory's geography.
(Judaism) a Jewish movement founded in Poland in the 18th century by Baal-Shem-Tov
(chemistry) A univalent anion (OH−) based on the hydroxyl functional group.
Sexual activity with a person of the same sex, sometimes (potentially offensive) restricted to same-sex sex between males.
A political ideology that favours progress towards better conditions in society.
To assign initial values to something.
A stockbroker.
A city in Iran, the seat of Kermanshah County's Central District and the capital of Kermanshah Province.
A melody added to an existing one, especially one added to provide harmony whilst each retains its simultaneous identity; a composition consisting of such contrapuntal melodies.
Yogurt that has been strained to filter or remove the whey and thus has a consistency between that of yogurt and cheese.
A place that produces, processes, or sells such products:
A city in Iran, the seat of Mashhad County's Central District and the capital of Razavi Khorasan Province.
integrated circuit

A (usually women's) team sport derived from basketball, with seven players on each side who attempt to score goals by passing a ball and throwing it into the opponent's goal, which is a raised hoop with a net at one end of the playing area. Unlike basketball, a player in possession of the ball cannot move until the ball is passed to another player.
A type of naturally occurring black glass produced by volcanoes.
A Romance language spoken in Occitania, a region of Europe that includes Southern France, Auvergne, Limousin, and some parts of Catalonia and Italy.
(zodiac constellations) A zodiacal constellation of the northern summer said to depict a man (Asclepius) holding a serpent; the serpent is the constellation Serpens.
(education) Events to orient new students at a school; events to help new students become familiar with a school.
(sport) The act of racing across unfamiliar place using a map and compass.
To shine; to make a surface very smooth or shiny by rubbing, cleaning, or grinding.
To cause (something) to be smooth and shiny by rubbing; put a shine on (something); polish (something).
To polish and make shiny by rubbing.
To make (something, such as a surface) bright, shiny, and smooth by, or (by extension) as if by, rubbing; to polish, to shine.
(structural, _, architecture) A column or short wing wall attached to the foundation wall which provides lateral support, or to support a vertical load that does not fall on the foundation wall.
(countable) something that restrains, ties, fastens or secures
Dogmatic or partisan.
Any of very many photosynthetic prokaryotic microorganisms, of phylum Cyanobacteria.
Of or pertaining to Slovenia, the Slovenes or the Slovene language.
A paramilitary division under the German Nazi Party, operating from 1921 until being disbanded in 1934.
The act of bathing; an instance of this; the taking of a bath.
rodent
The act of setting oneself on fire, especially as a form of protest.
